simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to אֲדֹרָם (H151) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: אֲדֹרָם (ʼĂdôrâm) means Adoram (or Adoniram), an Israelite First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 12 18.

definitions.full: H151. Adoram אֲדֹרָם (contracted or corrupt, compare foregoing) same official, under David 2Sam 20:24 , & Rehoboam 1Kin 12:18 (= הֲדֹרָם 2Chr 10:18 ).
